areas.formula: the prepared derived.area entries whose params_hash matches the running code and settings (A17.10); n_frames and n_visits counted from each summary

frames.source: synthetic fixture: made-up frame list, not SPHEREx data

coverage.formula: per visit, the union of its frames' s_region clipped to the area (A17.1)

steps.source: synthetic fixture: counts of the fixture's own dots and tracks
steps.formula: labels counted in /dots, statuses and verdicts counted in /tracks (A17.3 to A17.5)

name: area known object of an unknown kind

positions.source: synthetic fixture: made-up positions of made-up objects
positions.assumption: orbit solutions from SkyBoT (candidates) and JPL Horizons (positions) as of fetched_at, seen from SPHEREx (500@-163182)

position.formula: RA/Dec = the measured centroid (x, y) through the frame WCS (A17.2); here a linear tangent-plane map

photometry.source: synthetic fixture: made-up x, y, flux, error, S/N, flags

label.source: synthetic fixture: labels set by the fixture generator
label.formula: glitch, fixed and star rules of A17.3 with the thresholds in method.settings

tracks.formula: tracklets and visit pairs of A17.4 (A17.12 for rate_grid) with the thresholds in method.settings

match.assumption: orbit solutions from SkyBoT (candidates) and JPL Horizons (positions) as of fetched_at, seen from SPHEREx (500@-163182)

name: area checks with a single catch rate

checks.psf: synthetic fixture: Gaussian, width measured on isolated stars of the area
checks.distance_model: synthetic fixture: u = 1/distance with distance 1.5 AU

test_mover.assumption: synthetic point sources added in memory to this area's recorded cutouts; PSF and distance model in method.checks

completeness.assumption: synthetic point sources added in memory to this area's recorded cutouts; PSF and distance model in method.checks

control.formula: tracks found on the same frames with the mid-times permuted at random; seeds in method.checks (A17.6)

tracks.formula: tracklets and visit pairs of A17.4 (A17.12 for rate_grid) with the thresholds in method.settings
